selection_policy: Curated operators with public primary financial disclosures. Sixteen historical comparison records include listed companies and one private IPO applicant; three additional private operators are an unranked coverage watchlist. Not an exhaustive market census.
coupon_selection_policy: Multiple reviewed USD fixed-note examples per company where reliable primary terms exist. Instruments are sortable, never company health/cost ranks. Some notes are confirmed at the company snapshot, others only at earlier dates; status and principal dates are explicit. This is not a complete security inventory.
method_notes: Borrowings are consolidated carrying values net of disclosed discounts/costs, excluding both operating and finance lease liabilities. They are not total liabilities or face principal.
Borrowings/assets uses the same reporting date for numerator and denominator. Every row retains its own date; no pro forma post-quarter updates are mixed in.
Cash is balance-sheet cash and cash equivalents, not total liquidity; restricted balances, investments and crypto assets are excluded where separately disclosed.
Compare business models carefully. A default AI-infrastructure group includes both GPU clouds and mixed transition businesses. Landlords and bitcoin miners are separate filters.
No health score, buy/sell recommendation, bond market yield or real-time quote feed is supplied.
